messages:
olivia: Quick sync — customer-42 rollout is scheduled for 10:20 PT today. I need a smoke owner, CS on standby for the first 30m, and marketing to confirm the announcement window. TL;DR: small config flip, can rollback quickly.

mike: I can own smoke. Will run the checklist and post pass/fail.

jess: I can be CS standby for the first 30. Please paste the exact rollback steps so we can rehearse.

laura: Marketing is okay with staging announcement at +15m and public send at +30m after we verify no regressions. We need a single sentence for the email header.

arjun: Rollback is: set rollout_pct=0, wait for drain, then revert feature flag commit. Full command: ```./deploy-cli set-flag customer-42 feature_x false && ./deploy-cli restart-routing customer-42```

olivia: Thanks — mike you'll run smoke starting T+0 (10:20). Use these smoke commands: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/predict -d '{"model":"rwd-base","input":"smoke"}' | jq .status``` then check latencies in console (route: customer-42->rwd-base). If >250ms for 3 consecutive requests, fail and rollback.

mike: Got it. I'll post timestamps and quick snippet results. Planning to run 5 concurrent checks and one end-to-end transaction through the app.

danielle: I've prepped the CS playbook snippet and escalation list, will paste to the thread after smoke passes. If smoke fails, we hold marketing and escalate to eng-oncall.

jess: Quick question — is there any data-migration step that could affect the API?

olivia: No data migration. It's a routing/config change only. No DB schema changes.

laura: Email header suggestion: "New performance profile for [Customer Name] — minimal impact expected". Approve?

arjun: Approve. Also tagging deploy-bot for the rollout window.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Scheduled job registered: customer-42-rollout @ 2026-03-17T10:20:00-07:00. Canary: 10% for 2m -> 50% for 3m -> 100%. Auto-rollback on error >=5% 5xxs in 1m.

mike: Canary started. First check: status OK, latency median 120ms. Posting logs: `200, 112ms, 118ms, 125ms`.

jess: CS ready. Playbook pasted: "If customer reports degraded performance, immediate steps: 1) confirm version in headers, 2) request request-id, 3) escalate to eng-releases + eng-oncall."

olivia: Marketing hold lifted at +15. Laura, please queue the staging announcement. We'll wait for +30 to public.

arjun: Canary -> 50% now. Monitoring console shows 0 errors.

mike: End-to-end transaction succeeded. No errors, throughput nominal.

olivia: Proceeding to 100%. Deploy-bot, continue rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 100%. Monitoring thresholds remain nominal.

mike: Final smoke pass at T+10 — all checks green. Latency 110-140ms.

jess: CS: sending note to customer success lead with the summary and playbook.

laura: Staging announcement sent. Public send queued for T+30. Subject line updated with the approved header.

danielle: Uploading incident template and contact matrix to the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch/customer-42-playbook

arjun: Leaving rollback steps here again for quick access: `set-flag customer-42 feature_x false` -> `restart-routing customer-42` -> monitor for 5m.

olivia: Great work team. Final status: success, no rollback. I'll post the short release note for general channel and attach metrics after 1h. :tada:
